purpose: Automate only high-confidence primary-source date/identity verification for recurring U.S. macro releases. Any non-unique, unavailable or contradictory match remains UNRESOLVED_OFFICIAL_TRUTH.

US_INITIAL_JOBLESS_CLAIMS.source: U.S. DOL ETA Unemployment Insurance Weekly Claims

US_PCE.source: BEA Personal Income and Outlays news release/schedule

US_RETAIL_SALES.source: Census Advance Monthly Sales for Retail and Food Services

matching.official_occurrence_date: Date explicitly published by the primary authority for the release/decision, never inferred from prediction-market close or economic value.
matching.accept_rule: Exactly one official occurrence for the same eligible subject lies within +/-3 calendar days of the pretruth event reference date AND the authoritative source can be captured/referenced under W4B-OET-v1.0.
matching.tie_rule: Two or more candidate official occurrences in the window => UNRESOLVED_OFFICIAL_TRUTH.
matching.no_match_rule: Zero official occurrences in the window => UNRESOLVED_OFFICIAL_TRUTH.
matching.official_event_id: Use frozen W4OT1 formula with the official occurrence date and the same eligible subject key.
